name: Brute Strength raises Physical crit damage and Flesh Hook/Chains of Malice/Chainwhip range (#1092)
contract: Brute Strength 680723 reads 'Increases your critical damage dealt with Physical attacks by 10% and increases the range of Flesh Hook, Chains of Malice, and Chainwhip by 5 yds' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z). Effect 0 is the native aura 163 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS), MiscValue 1 (SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL), BasePoints 10. Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus doubles a melee-class spell's base damage before applying this bonus, so a probe of 1000 base damage reads 1000 extra at baseline and 1200 extra with the 10% bonus applied to the full 2000 crit total - a 1.2 ratio on the raw metric. Effect 1 is aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 5 (SPELLMOD_RANGE), BasePoints 5, classmask (4718592,0,1) combining Flesh Hook's (500020) dword2 bit0, Chains of Malice's (803185) dword0 bit22, and Chainwhip's (800081) dword0 bit19. At level 60 the owned Flesh Hook rank is 501490, the owned Chainwhip rank is 503365, and Chains of Malice (803185) and Infernal Strike's owned rank 501518 have no level-scaled chain (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h).
